run_clock_install: run the Clock install method to install a mock clock on a browser context
test_clock_fast_forward: test the Clock fast_forward method to advance simulated time by a number of ticks
refactor_clock_set_fixed_time: refactor the Clock set_fixed_time method to set a fixed simulated time on the browser context
review_clock_pause_at: review the Clock pause_at method to pause simulated time at a specified moment
